about: The 6 prompt layers. The frame is built like a multiplane cel set-up: far background, near background, the subject in the midground, then the foreground (world and subject layers), compiled as one 'depth' sentence. Each field has a label, help text, a trimming priority and a vocabulary. When a prompt is too long, fields are dropped lowest priority first. Fields at or above protect_at_or_above are never dropped.
